exercise.title: Major key or minor key, by ear
exercise.why: G major and E minor use the same seven notes, so what tells the two keys apart is the chord the music comes to rest on.

cells.text:
Press Play below to start the band in G major: two bars of G, then C and D. Listen for the chord where the music comes to rest, and call out "home" each time it comes round.
The chord boxes show it: home is G, a major chord, so the key is major.

Press Play below to start the band again. The notes are the ones of G major, with the same one sharp, but now the band rests on Em, a minor chord: the key is E minor. Call out "home" on each Em.
Then put on a song you like and listen for the chord it comes to rest on: major or minor?
